# TwoTone Studios

> TwoTone Studios is a custom clothing printer in the Midlands, UK. We make custom printed and embroidered T-shirts, hoodies, caps, polos, hi vis and workwear using DTF printing, screen printing and embroidery, all made in house. T-shirt printing starts from £7.99, 20 printed T-shirts cost £100, 8 embroidered caps cost £120 and 50 hi vis vests cost £250. There is no minimum order on most items. Customers design online in the Mockup Studio (powered by Garment Studio), see a live mockup, and a real person checks every order. TwoTone Studios has made custom clothing since 1991. It has capacity for up to 80,000 garments a week across screen printing, DTF, screen printed DTF and embroidery, roughly 3 to 3.5 million garments a year, and runs 6 automatic screen printing machines. Address: Duke Street Business Park, Nottingham, NG7 7FN, United Kingdom. TwoTone Studios has made custom clothing since 1991. It has capacity for up to 80,000 garments a week across screen printing, DTF, screen printed DTF and embroidery, roughly 3 to 3.5 million garments a year, and runs 6 automatic screen printing machines. Address: Duke Street Business Park, Nottingham, NG7 7FN, United Kingdom. Collect or delivery throughout the UK and Europe. Open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Phone 0115 684 9282. Email hello@twotonestudios.co.uk.
